schedule.label: Fast lane
schedule.summary: Collects the fast-lane sources (government advisories, the KEV list and the fastest news feeds), merges and scores what is new by rule, and republishes the site's data.

schedule.label: Normal lane
schedule.summary: Collects the normal-lane sources, merges and scores what is new by rule, and republishes the site's data.

schedule.label: Ground-truth sync
schedule.summary: Reads the public registers (CISA KEV, EPSS, CVE scores, OSV advisories and MITRE ATT&CK) and rescores and republishes any event whose facts changed.

schedule.label: AI enrichment
schedule.summary: Asks a model to triage, brief and estimate the severity of a small batch of new events, and to suggest MITRE techniques, within the month's budget; an event it has not reached is published without them.

schedule.label: Daily digest
schedule.summary: Sends the morning digest to Telegram at 07:10 Sydney time; 08:10 and 09:10 send it only if 07:10 did not.

schedule.label: Critical alerts
schedule.summary: After each collection and enrichment pass, sends Telegram an alert for a new critical or actively exploited event that matters to Australia, and updates on developing ones.

schedule.label: Discovery search
schedule.summary: Searches the web for feeds worth adding and queues each new one as a candidate; it adds no source itself.

schedule.label: Source gate
schedule.summary: Probes each candidate feed; one that passes enough healthy probes in a row becomes a source, and the next normal run collects it.

schedule.label: Model scan
schedule.summary: Reads OpenRouter's public model list and checks the enrichment models against the price and capability rules, dropping any that fail; it calls no model.

schedule.label: Model gauntlet
schedule.summary: Runs the current enrichment models and up to two challengers on a labelled test set; a better challenger is proposed for review, never switched to.

schedule.label: Watchdog
schedule.summary: Checks that the site, the collections and the other jobs are keeping up, and opens an incident, and tells the crew, when one is not.
